text:
Maria P: Heads-up: several interviewer training invites didn't go out after last night's ATS import.
Samir R: Which cohort?
Maria P: Talent ops -> backend/platform interviewers, about a dozen.
Alex K: Any sync errors in the logs?
Maria P: ATS reported `invalid boolean value \"YES\" for field interviewer_ready` in the summary.
Samir R: We tightened the CSV mapping to accept only `true/false` last sprint. Some exports still use `yes/no`.
Jamie L: Can we tolerate `yes/no` temporarily? Interviews start tomorrow.
Alex K: Quick patch: add normalizer `/(yes|y)/i -> true, /(no|n)/i -> false` in importer. I can hotfix and run a backfill.
Maria P: How long?
Alex K: 15-25 minutes to deploy and run backfill for affected rows.
Samir R: I'll re-export the team file and queue it for the backfill job.
Reina G: Appreciate it 64f interviewing schedule is tight.
ats-sync-bot: [02:12] ATS import error: row 78: invalid boolean "YES" for interviewer_ready
Alex K: Deployed transform to prod. Backfill job started `job=backfill-2065432100-1`.
nats-sync-bot: [02:30] backfill-2065432100-1 finished: 11 updated, 1 skipped (no calendar linked)
Maria P: Confirmed 11 invites sent, 1 pending (needs calendar connection). I'll follow up with that person.
Samir R: I'll add a CSV schema validator in the pipeline and a Slack alert if fields don't match expected types.
Jamie L: Also add a small note in Recruiting Ops runbook about this field mismatch and rollback steps.
Alex K: Adding unit tests for varied boolean formats so this doesn't regress.
Maria P: Thanks all, closing the loop :thumbsup:
